purpose: Test a separate pair-score threshold when either business address is missing
population: 20k natural entities, fixed outer folds 1-3; Fold4 CLOSED
model: Frozen NUMERIC-V2 LightGBM feature set and hyperparameters
selection: For each outer fold, fit two inner one-fold models; keep the existing inner-selected global threshold fixed and select only the missing-address threshold on inner OOF exact macro F0.5
hypothesis: Address-missing links are a concentrated false-negative group, but a distinct threshold may help only if extra true links outweigh false merges at per-entity macro F0.5
expected_gain: Uncertain, likely small; reject unless outer OOF improves with stable folds and acceptable precision
compute: Mac M5 CPU one LightGBM thread, 6 inner fits, no AWS cost
frozen_sub001: Do not change SUB-001 model, threshold or inference
